remarks: Year-round Ellicottville living awaits in this spacious 3-bedroom plus loft, 3 bath chalet, offering some of the most spectacular views of Holiday Valley’s slopes. The main level offers an open kitchen and dining area that flows into a dramatic living room with cathedral ceilings, floor to ceiling windows, and a striking custom sunburst wood enclosed electric fireplace. The primary bedroom and full bath are conveniently located on this level, while two additional bedrooms and a second full bath sit just a few steps up. Original woodwork and natural stone accents run throughout, creating a timeless mountain lodge feel. The lower entry level is designed for après ski relaxation, complete with a family room/den, wet bar, second electric fireplace, full bath, and an indoor sauna. Step outside to enjoy upper and lower decks with panoramic views—perfect for unwinding in the 6-person hot tub while watching night skiers or stargazing. The exterior is surrounded by established perennial gardens that provide beautiful summer landscaping. With Spruce Lake and Little Rock City just a short walk away, recreation is truly at your doorstep. Whether you’re seeking a personal getaway or a strong investment property, this chalet delivers the full Ellicottville experience.
